title: World trade in refined copper cathode, annual (UN Comtrade)
product: Refined copper cathodes and sections of cathodes, HS 740311

commodity.description: Cathodes and sections of cathodes, of refined copper

source.name: UN Comtrade Database, annual merchandise trade by reporter and partner (HS)
source.license: UN Comtrade data use and re-dissemination policy: free not-for-profit visualisation of limited amounts, no bulk download
source.attribution: Source: UN Comtrade Database, United Nations Statistics Division.

transformations: Data API, annual, HS 740311, exports and imports for every reporter and partner, one request per year and flow
Totals only: customs procedure C00, mode of transport 0, second partner 0 (the breakdowns would double-count)
Value: Comtrade's primary value, FOB for exports; CIF for imports, or FOB where the reporter values imports FOB
Weight: net weight in kg, else the quantity in kg; a reported figure before an estimate by UN Comtrade; none = missing
Checked that every reporter's partner records add up to its World total
Values kept as published; tonnes, shares, rankings and mirror gaps on the site are calculated from them

notes: Reporters send and revise annual figures over many months; the latest years are incomplete.
Exporters' and importers' figures for the same trade differ (FOB vs CIF, timing, country of origin vs consignment, confidentiality).
Imports are recorded by country of origin, which need not be the country the cargo was shipped from.
